body:
@foufrix InstantSearch Angular is not started today and will take time to build.

If you want to stick with Angular you should go for either the connectors API as @iam4x said. Or directly use the [JavaScript client](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript) and [the helper](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/).
